title: zeroize::Zeroizing wrapping password clone before spawn_blocking is correct hygiene
description: In CredentialStore::check(), the password is wrapped in zeroize::Zeroizing before moving into spawn_blocking. This ensures the copy on the blocking thread is cleared from memory after use. The original &str reference is not zeroized (a known limitation of Rust &str), but clearing the owned clone is meaningfully better than leaving it on the heap. Do not remove the Zeroizing wrapper to 'simplify' the code.
